def temp_from_ppm(delta):
    """
    Calculates temperature from given chemical shift

    >>> from watertemp import temp_from_ppm
    >>> temp_from_ppm(4.7)
    32.0
    >>> temp_from_ppm(5.5)
    -40.0

    """
    return 455 - (90 * delta)
